{{Quote|The Salvage Yard is the proving ground for real pilots. After a few runs through there, you can survive anything.|Jaard Reidan|<ref name="XWA" />}}
'''Jaard Reidan''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], holding the rank of [[Captain/Legends|captain]]. [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilots]] at that [[Time/Legends|time]] frequently tested their skills in the unofficial "[[pilot proving grounds]]," competing to set the best time on a series of courses through a Rebel [[Salvage Yard|salvage yard]] hidden in an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]]. Reidan posted times that compared well to some of the Alliance's best pilots across all courses and believed that the proving grounds helped pilots to develop the skills they needed to survive in [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]].<ref name="XWA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jaard Reidan was created for the [[1999]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''. When launching the pilot proving grounds, several quotes are shown on the screen, including one from Reidan.
